prompt:
Use case: stylized-concept. Asset type: one game ability VFX token atlas, 1024x1024 square RGBA with a truly transparent background. Exactly FOUR isolated hand-painted fantasy effect emblems in an exact evenly spaced 2 by 2 cell grid. Cell centers at 25% and 75% of image width/height. Keep each emblem entirely within the central 65% of its cell, with transparent gutters and no crossing between cells. No text, labels, frames, circles around icons, UI buttons, background, full characters, numbers, decorative borders, shadows or scenery. These are small rendered effect tokens and HUD icons; actual range shapes are rendered separately by the game. Strong distinct silhouette, detailed painted material, restrained glow, readable at 32px. Avoid large opaque panels. Depict characteristic tools/energy/material symbols, not a screenshot or miniature scene. Cell order: TOP LEFT passive, TOP RIGHT skill1, BOTTOM LEFT skill2, BOTTOM RIGHT ultimate. Original avatar: Thimble Briarwish. Character visual motifs: tiny elderly fae gardener hauling a giant squeaking terrarium barrow, patched mittens, roots growing through ceramic pots; no polymorph/massive-grow knockup kit.
TOP LEFT: Seedbank. Ability concept: after an ally uses cover Thimble created to block a projectile, she collects one Seed (max 2; one per source shot). Seeds improve next planter's hit points; never grant permanent ability amp.
TOP RIGHT: Plant Shelter. Ability concept: places a 40-GU dome planter lasting 4 s. It blocks **one arcing/lobbed enemy projectile**, not direct-fire bullets; ally and enemy walkers pass underneath freely. 2 HP baseline.
BOTTOM LEFT: Wheelbarrow Walk. Ability concept: pushes a planted shelter along a valid 55-GU ground segment for 2.5 s. Allies who stay in its moving shade gain minor HP regeneration; the caster is slowed while pushing. Cannot move through walls.
BOTTOM RIGHT: Traveling Orchard. Ability concept: sends **three** small low-roof planters along separate, explicitly visible 70-GU routes for 5 s. Each blocks one overhead attack then crumbles. The gaps remain traversable; Thimble cannot be in three places at once and is vulnerable while directing them.
